recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No FHIR core follow-up is needed for FHIR-11448; any remaining post-coordination guidance questions should be handled separately under issues such as FHIR-14029.
issue_request: FHIR-11448 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core vocab change request from the DSTU2 2016-09 ballot asking that Terminology Module use cases not be overly focused on operations and that coding use cases be added, including sending coded data, post-coordinated codes, code translations, and mixing local and standard codes.
initial_application: Jira comments record application in git commit 0b9ad5f8ad. That commit added seven Common Use Cases to source/terminology-module.html, including creating or referencing code systems and value sets, recording pre-coordinated and post-coordinated coded data, recording multiple local or standard code systems/translations, mapping data between terminologies, and declaring terminology service capabilities.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml lists terminology-module.html as the active Terminology module page, and source/modules.html links implementers to terminology-module.html#uses. Later terminology-module history changed nearby operation-related content but retained the coding use cases. Community searches found no conflicting Zulip or Confluence evidence. FHIR-14029 is a later Published vocab issue about detailed post-coordination guidance on terminologies.html, but it is a separate page/request and was not decided here.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit because the current build-scoped source already satisfies the FHIR-11448 request.
